shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (1, −4) in the left image with the marker at 2 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted function includes (1, −4) as its right endpoint. Right image: The interval excludes its left boundary 2.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
